title: Sheaves of commutative algebras on a scheme and their underlying modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A sheaf of commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebras is a sheaf $\mathcal A$ of commutative rings on the open-set site of $X$, together with a morphism of ring sheaves $\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal A$. Morphisms are ring-sheaf morphisms commuting with these structure morphisms; equivalently this category is the under category of $\mathcal O_X$ in sheaves of commutative rings. Its underlying $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is $\mathcal A$, viewed as the rank-one module over itself and restricted along $\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal A$.
